name: philosopy_benchmark
description: A benchmark that evaluates language models on philosophical knowledge, argument understanding, and ethical reasoning across a set of prompts/questions. It measures a model's ability to reason about classic philosophical problems, interpret arguments, and provide coherent, contextually appropriate answers. The dataset is intended to probe depth of conceptual understanding rather than surface-level factual recall.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but growing use for probing philosophical reasoning in NLP models.
